title: Set up performance counters in Windows Performance Monitor

facts.text: Start Windows Performance Monitor and expand Monitoring Tools to choose Performance Monitor.
In toolbar choose Add button to open Add Counters window.
Select computer running Business Central Server from drop-down list.
Expand Business Central in Available counters and select one or more counters.
Select one or more Server instances from Instances list.
Choose Add then OK to display counter data in Performance Monitor.
